test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa93c35753b3860e9a5a5e0685cd47e9c92b49fee86c50b059d7445178ffa172.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Taking dice position 1 as common

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33086055bdca26790e28052d2b667a8565d031235497b61da8d184e1c800f06d.png] 

Moving clockwise from the Common number 1,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3067c36fd4d1b887dd6d982c86101c2729792220b5a3ad8d0bb2e79eac32e95.png] 

Pairs of opposite numbers.

1 - 5

6 - 2

3 - 4

So, the opposite number of 1 is 5.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
